items.title: Mercor AI Confirms Data Breach Following Lapsus$ Claims of 4TB Data Theft
items.description: Mercor AI has officially confirmed a severe data breach following claims by the notorious Lapsus$ hacking group that they stole 4 terabytes of sensitive company data. The incident, stemming from a recent supply chain attack on the open-source LiteLLM project, has exposed proprietary source code, internal databases, and massive amounts of user-verification data.
